statement_blocker: The repository gives only existence of Ramanujan graphs. It does not fix the prime-power parameter, one-graph versus infinite-family versus explicit-construction conclusion, finite graph model, regularity and connectedness hypotheses, trivial-eigenvalue convention, spectral bound, algebraic construction data, exceptional cases, ordered binders, or exact conclusion. Importing these from the matching article title without inspecting and reviewing its theorem text would invent proposition-changing mathematics.
